name: format_number
purpose: Format a value as signed/unsigned decimal, upper/lower hexadecimal, octal, or binary according to a format byte and mode
arguments: value; destination buffer; format byte; format mode word; field width word

name: format_hex
purpose: Format an unsigned value as uppercase hexadecimal into a fixed-width NUL-terminated field
arguments: value; destination buffer; field width word; nonzero=space pad, zero=zero pad

name: format_decimal
purpose: Format an unsigned value as decimal into a fixed-width NUL-terminated field
arguments: value; destination buffer; field width word; nonzero=space pad, zero=zero pad

name: calc_alpha_address
purpose: Convert two alpha coordinates to the orientation-correct absolute VRAM word address

name: display_decimal_value
purpose: Format and draw a decimal value through a temporary chained-text descriptor
arguments: coordinate0; coordinate1; value; field width; nonzero=space pad, zero=zero pad; color/style

name: display_hex_value
purpose: Format and draw an uppercase hexadecimal value through a temporary chained-text descriptor
arguments: coordinate0; coordinate1; value; field width; nonzero=space pad, zero=zero pad; color/style

name: stop_text_effect
purpose: Deactivate a matching effect slot if present and clear the supplied descriptor chain

name: display_large_char_raw
purpose: Render one mapped large glyph with the rotated-display stride/attribute mode
arguments: alpha destination pointer; glyph index word; color/style word

name: display_large_char_at
purpose: Render one mapped large glyph with the standard-display stride/attribute mode
arguments: alpha destination pointer; glyph index word; color/style word

name: display_large_decimal_value
purpose: Format and draw a decimal value with the mapped large font
arguments: coordinate0; coordinate1; value; field width; nonzero=space pad, zero=zero pad; color/style

name: display_large_hex_value
purpose: Format and draw an uppercase hexadecimal value with the mapped large font
arguments: coordinate0; coordinate1; value; field width; nonzero=space pad, zero=zero pad; color/style
exceptional_convention: normal six-slot veneer sharing the 0x32F2 display tail

name: display_large_text_at
purpose: Build a temporary descriptor from coordinates and draw a mapped large-font string

name: clear_large_text
purpose: Clear the alpha cells occupied by a mapped large-font descriptor chain
return: D0.l=alpha-cell span cleared for the final descriptor

name: write_alpha_word
purpose: Write a raw word to one indexed alpha VRAM cell

name: wait_vblanks
purpose: Busy-wait for the requested number of changes to the OS VBLANK counter

name: set_text_position
purpose: Set the two leading descriptor coordinates and clear descriptor repeat byte 6
